rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as a genotype:treatment interaction, fits ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment in DESeq2 with explicit WT/vehicle reference levels, tests the interaction coefficient by Wald, extracts both simple effects (the KO effect as a composite contrast), applies ashr shrinkage, BH per contrast with alpha passed to results(), and adds an edgeR QL check on the same coefficient. QC is blind-VST PCA, distance heatmap and library sizes with a flag-don't-drop policy sized to n=4 per cell; the low-count filter (>=10 in >=4 samples) is minimal and tied to the smallest cell; counts enter raw with size factors/TMM inside the models. Enrichment is fgsea on the full ranked list by Wald stat with a 15-500 window, seed, tested-gene universe and named human collections, docking only a point for deferring collection versions to runtime rather than naming them. The report enumerates method, versions, design, contrasts, thresholds, tested/significant counts and an explicit interaction-power caveat.
